profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Pinterest | Advisor @ Loyal VC
profile.summary: Software engineer with a background in full stack development, consumer apps, startups, and venture capital.

positions.title: Entrepreneur in Residence for iStartup Lab
positions.description: First EIR for the Informatics department's iStartup Lab (https://startup.ischool.uw.edu/). Responsibilities include working with iStartup Lab directors and mentoring UW students interested in the startup space.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching assistant for INFO 498: Entrepreneurship Fundamentals for Devs, Designers, and PMs

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Full-stack intern on the Ads Measurement Ingestion team under the Conversion Visibility pod.
- Redesigned and implemented user match, cookie-like feature workflow to reduce perceived traffic to www.pinterest.com
- Hosted design reviews, led cross-team collaboration and discussions as part of proposal for redesign
- Utilized Javascript, React, Node to make changes to the Pinterest UI and Java, YAML to make changes to the backend servers, monitoring tools, and the Pinterest Tag (used in advertiser sites to track conversions from www.pinterest.com)
- Worked closely with many teams outside of my own given that this was a full stack feature

positions.title: Associate Director of DubHacks Next, Head of Projects
positions.description:
Build, from the ground-up, the UW’s first student-run startup based on the past success of UC Berkeley’s CalHacks fellowship and Stanford’s Cardinal Ventures with the vision of turning Seattle into the next Silicon Valley.

Feel free to reach out: sierra@dubhacks.co

positions.title: Executive Organizer for DH Next Startup Incubator
Full Stack Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Proposed software architecture of new customer-facing SaaS cloud networking microservice product
- Created UI and backend REST APIs using TypeScript, NodeJS, Angular, MySQL, and Docker for “App Store” platform to build
minimum viable product
- Designed UX workflow and Figma mockups for new service

positions.title: Full Stack Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Design the onboarding/registration screens using React Native and TypeScript
- Create Entity Framework APIs in C# and using .NET to retrieve information from the database to use in frontend
- Write documentation for MacOS setup as the first MacOS user and developer

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught Minecraft Modding and Java to children ages 8-15.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on the machine learning algorithm to match up possible dates for dating app startup using Rust and Rusqlite (Rust version of SQLite).
- Created Snapchat-like filter using Object Detection in Rust and Python.
- Organized events to ensure inclusivity of program.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Reformatted code and wrote documentation for the open-source machinelearning.NET code repository to increase readability 
- Coded new transfer learning APIs for the machinelearning.NET repository in C# and Python
- Experimented with PyTorch and TensorFlow to base APIs off of

honors.title: Science Student of the Class of 2020
honors.description: Awarded the science student of the class of 2020 by the science department for performance in STEM classes, involvement in science-related activities, and overall commitment to science.
honors.issuer: Issued by Kamiak High School’s Science Department · Jun 2020

projects.title: Break-Out Chrome Extension
projects.description: As part of DubHacks, create a Google Chrome extension that helps people fight Zoom fatigue by reminding them to take breaks and providing them links to fun resources to unwind.
